# **GAME PASA**  {#game-pasa}

# **Introduction** {#introduction}

Our five-person team has developed the Game Pasa website, which is a developing platform that aims to enhance the gaming experience for hobbyists and gamers alike. Derived from the functionality of Steam, Game Pasa is a cohesive platform whereby users can surf, find, and download various games depending on varying interests and preferences.

 This project, done as part of the coursework in our college, reflects our personal and team web development, collaboration, and creative problem-solving skills. Our goal was to create an intuitive, easy-to-use interface that not only facilitates game discovery but also offers a smooth navigation experience and accessibility across devices. Throughout the development phase, We used HTML to shape the game list and navigation, while CSS keeps it looking clean and smooth.

 We put it together in Visual Studio Code and tested it on Chrome. It’s got a fake buying system that feels legit, making it a fun way to show off our web skills without any hassle. Game Pasa reflects our commitment to delivering a practical, real-world application while honing our technical expertise and understanding of user-centric design. This documentation provides an in-depth look at our journey from conceptualization to deployment highlighting the objectives achieved, challenges overcome, and lessons learned. By building Game Pasa, we’ve not only created a functional gaming platform but also laid a strong foundation for our future endeavors in the tech industry.

# **Our Goal** {#our-goal}

* Learn HTML, CSS, and JavaScript better by building a website.  
* Solve coding problems, like fixing login and dark/light mode issues.  
* Work better as a team by sharing ideas and splitting tasks.  
* Manage time well by balancing schoolwork and project deadlines.  
* Break big tasks, like connecting login logs to Google Sheets, into small steps.  
* Feel more confident by finishing a tough project, preparing for future challenges.  
* Create good work quickly, even when time is short.  
* Use tools like YouTube tutorials and AI to learn and fix errors faster.  
* Make a user-friendly website that looks good and works well.  
* Build skills to handle real-world tech problems in future projects.

# **Development** {#development}

**![][image5]**  
This is the home page of our website which serves as the landing screen for Game Pasa, introducing users to the platform with a bold tagline and a call-to-action to explore the game library.  
**![][image6]**  
The Library page displays the user's personal collection of games that they are interested in. It allows users to quickly launch recently played games and view their status.  
**![][image7]**

The Game Pasa Store page contains different games which are highly loved by today’s generation hardcore gamers and they can easily download any games after purchasing. New games are updated after we have purchased the license of the game.

![][image8]

The Game Pasa Community page is the webpage where the number of users of our website is shown and through discord the users can communicate with each other to make a better environment for the gamers.

![][image9]

The About Us page contains the information of the developers of the website Game Pasa. This webpage also helps the users to know the motive of the developers and further future plans.

![][image10]

The Game Pasa Sign-Up Page helps the users to login in to our website using their credentials. By login, all the information about the game purchased, time spent, history etc will be saved in our database which will help them for smooth functioning.

# **Conclusion** {#conclusion}

Building Game Pasa, a gaming store website named after the Newari word "pasa" meaning friend, was a great experience. This project, assigned by our teacher Pujan Thapa Magar, let us create a website using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. We learned a lot about coding and teamwork.

We faced challenges, like managing time during pre-board exams and fixing CSS and JavaScript issues. Features like the login system, which shows the user’s name, allows logout, and logs name and time to a Google Sheets file, and the dark/light mode switch were tricky. YouTube tutorials helped us learn, and AI tools like ChatGPT and Grok fixed errors. We also used web tools to connect login logs to Google Sheets. Our teacher’s deadline extension after exams helped us finish.

We researched tutorials and gaming store websites for design ideas and learned JavaScript for features like the dark mode switch. We also improved time management and team communication, staying ahead during the three-week project (Week 0, Week 2, Week 3).

We got to learn HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, and learned to use tutorials and AI effectively. We also improved at teamwork and handling stress. This project showed us that planning and hard work lead to success.

In the end, Game Pasa was fun to build. Despite challenges, we made a website we’re proud of, with features like login logs and a mode switch. It improved our skills and prepared us for future tasks.
